name: spotify-mcp
description: Spotify Ads (Spotify Ads Manager) (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, get_report, pause_resume

platform_mcp_spotify_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_spotify_client_id.description: Client ID of your Spotify for Developers app registered for the Ads API (the Ads API Terms must be accepted for it; allowlisting can take an hour).

platform_mcp_spotify_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_spotify_client_secret.description: The app's client secret (HTTP Basic on https://accounts.spotify.com/api/token).

platform_mcp_spotify_refresh_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SPOTIFY_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_spotify_refresh_token.description: Refresh token from one authorization-code login with your Ads Manager account (https://developer.spotify.com/documentation/ads-api/quick-start); it does not expire. One-hour access tokens are minted from it.

platform_mcp_spotify_business_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SPOTIFY_BUSINESS_ID
platform_mcp_spotify_business_id.description: Spotify Ads business id whose ad accounts list_accounts returns (GET /businesses lists yours).

platform_mcp_spotify_ad_account_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SPOTIFY_AD_ACCOUNT_ID
platform_mcp_spotify_ad_account_id.description: Ad account id used by pause_resume (the campaign PATCH path is /ad_accounts/{ad_account_id}/campaigns/{campaign_id}).

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /ads/v3/businesses: the businesses of the logged-in user ({businesses: [{id, name, type, status}]}).

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: GET /ads/v3/businesses/{business_id config}/ad_accounts: ad accounts under the business for the current user (currency_code, status, ad_account_role).

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: GET /ads/v3/ad_accounts/{ad_account_id}/campaigns (limit up to 50, offset; `status` filters statuses: ACTIVE, PAUSED, ARCHIVED…). Budgets live on ad sets (budget.micro_amount), not campaigns.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: GET /ads/v3/ad_accounts/{ad_account_id}/aggregate_reports?entity_type=CAMPAIGN&granularity=LIFETIME&fields=IMPRESSIONS&fields=CLICKS&fields=SPEND with report_start/report_end at UTC midnight (range within 90 days): one row per campaign whose `stats` is a list of {field_type, field_value} (SPEND in the account currency). campaign_id is not applied; first page only (continuation_token).

tools.name: pause_resume
tools.description: PATCH /ads/v3/ad_accounts/{ad_account_id config}/campaigns/{campaign_id} {status: PAUSED|ACTIVE}. Resuming restarts spending.
